answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 168983 Country: India Title: What is the meaning and spelling of Ariz Rahman? Question: What is the meaning and spelling of Ariz Rahman? Answer ID: 168983 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 675/597/M=06/1440) Areez means wide and vast. Rahman is among the beautiful names of Allah, it means All-Merciful. The spelling is: Areezur Rahman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
